_note: Necessary conditions for a PRD (J2_OUTPUT=prd). Code checks each one on prd.md after every build; the PRD is workable only when all are met and Audit accepts. "check" names the code check in j2.condition_met().

conditions.text: All six sections are present and not empty
Requirement ids are unique and sequential (R1, R2, ...)
No invented facts: every number and email comes from the charter or the Requester's answers
Every goal has a matching success metric
